question: According to the Census of India 2011, which of the following states has the highest Hindu population percentage of total population?
solution:
The correct answer is __Himachal Pradesh__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hinduism is the largest religion in India. According to the 2011 Census of India, 966.3 Million people identify as Hindu, representing 79.8% of the country's population.
 
• In Himachal Pradesh, 95.17 % of the population belongs to the Hindu community.
 
• While Mizoram is with 2.75 %, the lowest percentage of the Hindu population in the state.
 
• Dadra and Nagar Haveli have 93.93 % of the Hindu community which is the highest among UTs and Lakshwdeep is with 2.77% which is the lowest among the UTs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first ever CENSUS in India was conducted by Lord Mayo.
 
• Uttar Pradesh has the highest population state according to Census 2011.
 
• Sikkim has the Lowest Population state according to Census 2011.
 
• Kerala has the highest Literacy state according to Census 2011.
 
• Bihar has the Lowest Literacy state according to Census 2011.
 
• Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India, founded in 1961 by Government of India **Ministry of Home Affairs**, for arranging, conducting and analysing the results of the demographic surveys of India including Census of India and Linguistic Survey of India.
